analysis.cohort: All frozen306 post-open/expert-open frames and all18 models, both conditions. Preserve original per-model labels, all65 events including zero selected coverage, all30 demos and empty groups. No new frame selection.
analysis.margin: abs(float64(original archived gripper action)); report raw original/changed/response and min/median/max/mean. No near-zero cutoff, threshold sweep, probability or force interpretation.
analysis.partition: Strict original and changed signs in {-1,0,+1}; retain all9 cells. Correct is negative for these expert-open frames; harmed=old<0,new>=0, split positive-close versus exactly-zero. Persistent-at-frame=old>=0,new>=0, not necessarily temporally sustained.
analysis.reference: Original-correct and original-wrong distributions per same model and selected phase; case empirical margin rank among original-correct frames is descriptive, not significance.
analysis.crossing_identity: For harmed old<0,new>=0: positive delta_g = abs(old_g)+new_g. Report delta_g/abs(old_g), not explained fraction or causal attribution.
analysis.temporal: Within identical task/seed/arm/condition/demo/open-event, group sorted observed action t; consecutive means actual t+1, never list adjacency across a missing step, event, demo, seed or model.
analysis.runs: Report old-wrong, changed-wrong, harmed and persistent-at-frame runs on frozen selected expert-open lags1..5. Temporal repetition means length>=2; zero-length has no inferred endpoint. Keep full availability, missing lags and left/right scope censoring. No extrapolation beyond observed selection.
analysis.extension: For each harmed run record containing changed-wrong run and count of old-wrong frames in that connected run; this separates only-new-error runs from joining/extending existing errors, not mutually exclusive physical mechanisms.
analysis.outputs: Every harmed case raw values/lag/event/model IDs, all cohorts and event patterns including zeros, per-model/task-arm/task summaries, model-frame versus unique source-frame/event counts, condition overlap, no pooled-task rate or independent-sample significance.
analysis.decision: Read-only descriptive audit only. Keep500/stabilization5/currentloss and all prior stop decisions. No automatic new training, inference, SPT/Knowledge/Module promotion.

failure_rule: Stop on pin/complete-status/model/source-role/shape/dtype/finite/bounds/frozen-frame-sign/parity/count mismatch, preserve existing files and partial failure metadata; no relaxed gates.
